changes.text: `saccade.act` may authorize a bounded continuous run only from one current `reflex_target` object carrying the current loop-class authority. The Node Broker, under the original request deadline and cancellation identity, repeatedly selects only current same-document targets with the same loop class, dispatches each exact current action token once, and requires the safe occurrence to advance before continuing. A registered bridge may define that occurrence as a completed exact-target Extension software dispatch only when the page exposes no live semantic counter; its release conformance must reconcile the final page-owned aggregate with the dispatch count. Pre-dispatch stale work may be skipped; any ambiguous or occurrence-unverified dispatch stops the loop with `outcome_unknown` and is never replayed. The report is bounded and value-free. This adds no seventh tool, Agent polling, arbitrary coordinate authority, native backend, or Rust route.

changes.text: A bounded reflex request may include one current `start_object_id`. The Broker fully preflights it as exactly one current clickable button in the same document, dispatches it once under the original request identity and deadline, and begins the loop only after that start action is accepted and semantically verified. It never hides submit, navigation, upload, replacement rebinding, or automatic replay inside the start step.
